title: core.command.v1 PostTransfer payload
description: One-step debit and credit when no external party is involved (P2P, cash in/out). Needs customer authorisation: it carries mw-auth's assertion (spec 18.7, D22) or, until ticket 72, the deprecated encryptedPin (spec 6.3), exactly one of them, except BULK_DISBURSE: the org authorised the whole batch by maker-checker in the org portal (ticket 34), so a bulk child carries neither. With an assertion the payload also carries the request's idempotencyKey, which the core needs to recompute the assertion's txnHash.

idempotencyKey.description: The mw.txn.request.v1 idempotencyKey; part of the assertion's txnHash.
